Web Design & Development

Direct mail drives people online. We build the website they land on — mobile-ready, fast, and designed to convert the traffic your mailers generate.

Websites That Work With Your Direct Mail

When a direct mail piece lands in someone's mailbox, most recipients look up the sender online before responding. If your website is outdated or doesn't load on mobile, you lose the lead your mailer generated. We build WordPress websites for Hudson Valley businesses that complete the marketing loop — a landing page your mail recipients can actually use. Mobile-responsive, fast-loading, and designed to convert traffic from your direct mail campaigns into calls, form submissions, or orders.

We handle design, development, content, hosting, and ongoing maintenance. Every site is built on WordPress with responsive design, on-page SEO, contact forms, and Google Analytics. We can add landing pages tied to specific mail campaigns so you can track response rates. Because we also handle the direct mail side, your printed piece and your website can share the same design language, messaging, and calls to action.

What's Included

Custom Design
Unique layouts tailored to your brand — no cookie-cutter templates.
Mobile-Responsive
Every site adapts to phones, tablets, and desktop screens automatically.
Search Engine Optimization
On-page SEO, local schema markup, and Google Business integration.
Hosting & Maintenance
Reliable hosting, SSL certificates, backups, and ongoing updates.
Contact Forms & CTAs
Lead capture forms that feed directly into your CRM or email.
Analytics & Tracking
Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and monthly reporting.

Direct Mail + Web = More Conversions

We design your website and your mail pieces together so they share a consistent brand identity. When a prospect receives your postcard and visits your website, they see the same colors, messaging, and call-to-action — building trust and driving action.

Our Web Portfolio

Cornerstone Services has designed and built websites for businesses across the Hudson Valley and beyond. Our sites range from simple informational pages for local service providers to multi-page sites with e-commerce, booking systems, and custom integrations.

In addition to crst.net, we manage domains including crstweb.com and donerightmail.com. Contact us to discuss your website project and see examples of our work.

Web Design FAQ

Do you only build websites for direct mail clients?

We primarily build websites for businesses that also use our direct mail services, but we are open to standalone web projects. Our strongest work is when we can align the website with the mail campaign — same messaging, same offer, same landing page for the URL printed on the mail piece.

What platform do you build on?

We build on WordPress for most client sites. It is manageable by non-technical staff, well-supported, and works with every major marketing tool. For smaller campaigns we also build simple static landing pages that load quickly and are easy to maintain.

Can you create a specific landing page for a mail campaign?

Yes. Campaign-specific landing pages are one of the most effective ways to track mail response rates. The page URL goes on the mail piece, anyone who visits it came from the mailing, and you can measure exactly how many people responded.

Do you provide ongoing hosting and maintenance?

Yes. We offer hosting and maintenance plans for sites we build. This includes security updates, plugin updates, uptime monitoring, and basic content changes. We do not host sites we did not build.

How long does a website take to build?

A basic five-page WordPress site typically takes 4–6 weeks from kickoff to launch, assuming content and images are provided promptly. More complex sites with custom functionality, e-commerce, or member portals take longer.

What do you need from me to start?

We need your logo (vector if available), your company colors and brand guidelines, the pages you want on the site, and your content (text and photos). If you need help with copy or photography, let us know and we can discuss options.
